now one-element numeric array, Inf [null] — Inf--null-inside--array rule cohort’s age_groups time_at_risk use. older shapes still load. 0.4.0 added cohort sets — cohort gained parent_cohort, prevalence gained denominatorCohortId / outcomeCohortId (null = IDs set) — aligned Prevalence estimators way 0.3.1 aligned Incidence: parameters use argument names order, strata replaces stratifications, sensitivity_analyses dropped , prevalence analysis_type names estimator (estimatePointPrevalence / estimatePeriodPrevalence). 0.4.1 dropped strata_variables denominator kinds. generateDenominatorCohortSet() puts age_group sex denominator table nothing else, columns analysis may stratify never author’s choose. textarea agree wrong — wrong dangerous case: naming extra ETL column made strata picker offer validator accept , strata = generator never satisfy. columns now fixed (STRATA_VARIABLES app/R/cohort_kinds.R). older file’s declared columns dropped load, analysis stratified column beyond two now fails validation — honest outcome, since never going run. 0.4.2 aligned denominator kinds generators, way 0.3.1 aligned Incidence estimateIncidence() 0.4.0 aligned Prevalence prevalence estimators.
